text:
Alex P.: Quick question — for models that fail the full golden-suite, can we agree on a bootstrap flow that synthesizes provisional golden probes so we can get runtime compatibility checks in CI?
Maria (ML): interested. what do you mean by "synthesize" exactly? small heuristics or sampled inputs?
Alex P.: idea: if tokenizer/manifest is missing or quantized artifact is off, create a lightweight golden set by sampling from model's own generation at short seqlen + canonical prompts. Mark them as "bootstrap" so we track provenance.
Devon: hmm. Danger is we accept a model that memorizes the canonical prompts. need ablation to detect overfitting to probes.
Samir: agreed. maybe run ablation: holdout 20% prompts, generate with temperature sweep, then compute delta on relevant metrics (latency, perplexity, embedding-consistency).
Maria (ML): +1. Also we should enforce a separate KPI: "acceptance drift" = max delta between bootstrap and golden baseline on eval set. threshold ops decided by model tier.
Lina: operational question — how do we surface bootstrap vs canonical in console? can we tag and hide from prod rollouts until vetted?
Devon: tag yes. rollout rules: bootstrap-only models get traffic=0 in Dedicated by default. Manual gating required to bump.
Alex P.: rough CLI prototype:```bash
# create bootstrap probes from model v0.3
ri-admit bootstrap --model=v0.3 --n=50 --max-seqlen=64 --out=bootstrap.json
ri-admit run --smoke --golden=bootstrap.json --ablation=0.2
```
CI-Bot: Test run queued: admit-smoke/1758210000 — will report pass/fail in thread.
CI-Bot: smoke result: FAIL — acceptance_drift=0.18 (threshold 0.12), latency_regress=+13%
Samir: failure ok — shows bootstrap caught something. question: is 12% a universal threshold? probably not. set per-model-class in registry.
Maria (ML): we should also add a lightweight statistical test to detect memorization: sample N distinct prompts from public corpus and check repetition rate / overlap with probe set.
Alex P.: agreed. tradeoffs: more probes => better coverage but higher cost and potential for overfitting. proposal: default 50 bootstrap probes + 3 temp settings, ablation 20%. configurable per-admit-profile.
Lina: I'll sketch console UX: admit record with tags [bootstrap, manual-vet-required], diff view showing probe->prod delta, and an "escalate to QA" button.
Devon: implementation note: keep bootstrap artifacts ephemeral and signed. store in registry with provenance so audits can trace origin.
Samir: can we add a health metric that flags when bootstrap->golden delta trends upward across versions? alert on trend slope > X.
Maria (ML): yes — "acceptance drift trend" metric. important to notify if drift accumulates even within thresholds.
Alex P.: sounds like consensus. next steps: Lina + Dev to design tag UX + rollout defaults; Maria + Samir to define metrics and ablation test; I'll prototype CLI and a minimal bootstrap generator.
Devon: ack. I'll file a short RFC follow-up with the ops knobs.
Alex P.: thanks all. leaving the thread for PRs and RFC pointers. :thumbsup:
